transcribe_audiofile: transcribe an audio file to text using the ASRGenerator with a HuggingFace or Fairseq ASR model
load_audiofile: load an audio file and apply resampling and layer normalization for ASR model input
compute_emissions: compute CTC emission logits from an audio waveform tensor using a Fairseq or HuggingFace ASR model
decode_emissions: decode CTC emission logits into a text transcription string using a torchaudio CTC decoder
retrieve_asr_config: retrieve an ASR model configuration dict from a JSON config file by language key and version
